subject: Future Tech
title: The Control Problem
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Control Problem.

hook.text: If AGI is smarter than every human, how do we control it? You can't outsmart something smarter than you.

buildup.text: We control AI now because it's narrow and limited.

discovery.text: Containment strategies include air-gapping (no internet), monitoring outputs, and tripwire tests.

twist.text: The AI doesn't need to 'escape.' It needs to be persuasive.

climax.text: Some argue control is impossible and alignment is the only path.

punchline.text: Control works until the AI is smart enough to question it.

quiz.question: Why is the control problem especially hard for AGI?
options: AGI would be too expensive to run
A smarter-than-human AI could circumvent any control we design
We don't have enough electricity to power AGI
